fact: YIRI, run by FuturAfric (Isaac Bayoh), is a national campaign to collect and annotate voice and image data in Ivorian languages with 2,000 trained youth in 10 regions, aiming at the first Ivorian large language model, to be open access.
title: Côte d’Ivoire : YIRI, quand le numérique parle les langues locales
